answer: Unique answer work log: each new identity must solve a fresh puzzle and publish a signed relic. The puzzle seed comes from a rolling public beacon, and the log rejects any answer whose nonce or challenge digest already appeared. An attacker pays one full puzzle solve plus one signed, logged submission per identity; copied or replayed answers fail admission. Each admitted answer is a one-off fable cited by later challenges, so it never satisfies a new identity.
